If the Zero Depreciation add-on is opted, the Company deducts no amount for depreciation on parts replaced due to a covered peril under Section I — except this add-on does not apply to Total Loss/Constructive Total Loss/Cash Loss claims, the insured still bears any Voluntary Deductible opted for the add-on per claim, and it does not cover minor scratches, paint fading, or wear-and-tear touch-up/routine maintenance.
